title: SpaceX完成400亿美元债务融资 用于AI芯片
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Elon Musk says SpaceX has closed a $40 billion debt deal to pay for the chips it needs to fuel its artificial intelligence ambitions.
segments.zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，SpaceX已完成400亿美元债务交易，用于支付其推动人工智能雄心所需的芯片。

segments.en: Posting on X, he said the firm finalised the debt raise thanks to its investment grade ratings and starling revenue.
segments.zh: 他在X上发帖称，得益于其**级评级和惊人的收入，公司完成了此次债务融资。

segments.en: Bloomberg understands the parties are still engaged in pricing discussions.
segments.zh: 据彭博社了解，各方仍在进行定价讨论。

segments.en: Let's get more from Bloomberg's equity strategist Rahul Alman on this story.
segments.zh: 让我们从彭博社权益资产策略师拉胡尔·阿尔曼那里获取更多关于此事的分析。

segments.en: As he announced on this agreement, Musk suggested that debt markets at all but shut for Neo Clouds.
segments.zh: 在宣布这项协议时，马斯克暗示债务市场对新型云服务商几乎关闭。

segments.en: How important would this deal be for SpaceX?
Good morning, Stephen. Yes, there were very interesting comments from Elon Musk yesterday on X. I think what's interesting is that SpaceX is of course building something resembling a Neo Cloud and he
segments.zh: 早上好，斯蒂芬。是的，昨天埃隆·马斯克在X上发表了非常有趣的评论。我认为有趣的是，SpaceX当然正在构建类似新型云服务的东西，而他

segments.en: effectively was saying that demand for compute still remains strong but actually Neo Clouds which rely primarily on data center revenue and debt financing are going to struggle
segments.zh: 实际上是在说，对计算能力的需求仍然强劲，但主要依赖数据中心收入和债务融资的新型云服务商将面临困境

segments.en: going forward given the angst around the debt lobes on some of these balance sheets.
segments.zh: 未来，鉴于一些资产负债表上的债务压力引发的担忧。

segments.en: SpaceX of course did flip EBITDA positive in the most recent quarter and does have the balance sheet to build this out and I think Elon Musk was really emphasising that as
segments.zh: SpaceX当然在最近一个季度实现了EBITDA转正，并且拥有资产负债表来支持这一发展，我认为埃隆·马斯克确实在强调这一点。
